[P4] Plus-size
Plus-size or plus-sized may refer to : Plus-size clothing , a general term given to clothing proportioned specifically for people around size 12 and up in the U.S. Plus-size model , a fashion model who specializes in modeling the above-mentioned clothing Plus sizing , the practice of changing a vehicle 's wheels to a larger size and reducing the size of the tires ( tyres ) to compensate

Angellika Morton began as a straight size model and transitioned to plus-size modeling in 1997 . In 1999 , she became the first model to be inducted into the International Model Hall of Fame .
